मेकल mf. (-लः-ला)
 1. Name of a certain part of Vindhya mountain.
 2. A goat.

मेकलकन्यका f. (-का) The Narmadā river.
 E. मेकल or मेखल the name of
a Ṛṣi the supposed father, or of a mountain, the source of the
stream, and कन्यका daughter; hence also मेखककन्यका ।

मेकलाद्रिजा f. (-जा) The Narmadā river.
 E. मेकलाद्रि the Mekala moun-
tain, part of the Vindhya range, and ज born.
